subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should SessionCatalogProvider.createSession become a permanent generic plugin/protocol capability with the initial contract limited to a gateway-advertised model reference?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but a new plugin SDK and gateway protocol surface is a lasting compatibility commitment; code review cannot decide whether the initial model-only abstraction is sufficiently future-proof.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Accept the optional model-only capability as the supported initial contract and land after current-head validation completes.

options.title: Keep it internal for now
options.body: Use a bundled-plugin or UI-private seam until the generic catalog-creation requirements are better established.

options.title: Broaden the contract first
options.body: Pause landing and define a richer typed creation target if near-term catalogs require agent, host, runtime, or other creation metadata.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional model-only capability as the supported initial contract and land after current-head validation completes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway session and plugin-catalog ownership makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the permanent API-shape decision.
